description: React component for the main application of NoteEase, managing notes, theme, and CRUD operations with Supabase backend.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component for NoteEase app, handling state, effects, and UI rendering.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches theme between light and dark modes.

methods.name: handleNewNote
methods.description: Opens modal to create a new note.

methods.name: handleEditNote
methods.description: Opens modal to edit an existing note.

methods.name: handleSaveNote
methods.description: Saves a new or updated note via API calls.

methods.name: handleDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note after user confirmation.
